bandReport.notes: p12 is printed page 13; footer CYRF-S-TXLD/50A. All six items are whole on this page. STRUCTURE: a 'Directions for the following 2 (two) items' block opens near the foot of column 1 and its information paragraph continues into column 2; both of its items (25, 26) are on p12 and are complete, so that block does not spill. A SECOND block, 'Directions for the following 7 (seven) items' (four passages), opens at the foot of column 2 and 'Passage-1' begins there and is cut off mid-sentence at the page foot; NONE of its seven items appears on p12, so nothing from that block is transcribed here - it continues on the following page and is owned by a later band. COLUMN CROPS: the p12-c2 crop overlaps the right edge of p12-c1, so a narrow strip of column 1's line-ends is visible down the left side of c2 and the centred printed page number appears in both crops. No text is lost or duplicated in the body and reading order was unaffected; both columns were read from the column crops and cross-checked against p12.png. DEFECTS: 1 printed-grammar oddity, in the shared information paragraph, where a clause states that one officer 'occupies on' a side of the corridor with no object - transcribed verbatim, not corrected. 0 duplicate options, 0 unreadable items, 0 numbering skips, 0 figure-dependent items. No decimals occur anywhere on p12, so the raised-middle-dot convention was not exercised. OVERLAP WITH AN EXISTING FILE: 2018-p2.b2.json is marked 'IN PROGRESS - p12 done' and already carries items 21-26 from this same page. This band is an independent re-read. Items 21-24 agree character-for-character. Items 25-26 agree in wording but differ from b2 in two presentation choices, both deliberate here and both answer-neutral: (1) b2 renders the six single-letter person labels as inline LaTeX, while this band leaves them plain, following the brief's rule that ordinary prose is not wrapped in math and matching the sibling band 2018-p2.b4.json, which keeps person labels plain in the analogous puzzle at items 44-48; (2) b2 uses a straight ASCII apostrophe in the possessives, while this band uses the printed right single quotation mark U+2019, matching the print and the glyph convention of 2018-p2.b1.json. If the merge refuses on 25-26, those two points are the whole difference.
